comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
Check Box is an example of a Click Wrap (Explicit agreement) versus Browser Wrap (Implied agreement). 

Note: "if the user does not accept the agreement, don’t just force close or make the app quit out. Send the user back to the front page or title screen of your app to give them another opportunity to proceed if they wish."
https://medium.com/ui-collection/laws-of-design-how-to-display-your-legal-agreements-in-your-mobile-app-8dd09556bd48

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
https://privacypolicies.com/blog/gdpr-compliance-apps/

In order to comply with this requirement, your app must provide users with certain disclosures about the information you collect, as well as a checkbox, button or other means for users to actively click and confirm their consent for you to collect their data.

**You cannot pre-select a consent checkbox or button, or assume that continued use of your app meets the GDPR’s requirement of acquiring active consent.**
